text.p: Vicenza, taking advantage of an absent-minded Internazionale, edged closer to a UEFA Cup spot when they upset the Milan side 1-0 in Italy's serie A on Saturday.
Striker Alessandro Iannuzzi scored in the 22nd minute, tapping in a pinpoint cross that left former Italy goalkeeper Gianluca Pagliuca helpless.

Both sides had Cup finals on their mind, with Inter facing Germany's Shalke in the first leg of the UEFA Cup final next Wednesday and Vicenza travelling to Napoli for the first leg of the Italian Cup.
While the win improved Vicenza's chances in the wide open battle for UEFA Cup places, placing them seventh on 42 points, the loss could prove costly for Inter.

The Milan club, locked in a tussle with Parma for the runners-up spot and a consequent Champions League berth, will fall four points behind the 1995 UEFA Cup champions if they beat Atalanta on Sunday.
Juventus, who have 55 points, lead Parma by six points and can all but wrap up their second league title in the last three seasons with a home win on Sunday against fourth placed Sampdoria.
